items.organizationName: TR-CERT (Computer Emergency Response Team of the Republic of Türkiye)
items.scope: Vulnerability assignment related to its vulnerability coordination role.
Genetec products and solutions only.
Kong products; Kong Konnect, Kong Enterprise, Kong Mesh, and Kong Insomnia, including Kong Opensource; Kong Gateway, Kuma, Insomnia.
All issues related to Search Guard only.
Vulnerability assignment related to its vulnerability coordination role.
All ConnectWise products and services and vulnerabilities discovered by ConnectWise in third party products that are not within another CNA’s scope.

All Trellix Enterprise (formerly McAfee Enterprise and FireEye) products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Trellix Advanced Research Center (Trellix ACR) that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Hitachi products excluding Hitachi Energy and Hitachi Vantara products.
Vulnerabilities in supported Ivanti products and infrastructure, excluding third-party components, and meeting severity thresholds defined in Ivanti’s Disclosure Policy found here.
Yandex issues only.
End of life open source projects supported by HeroDevs if hosted on HeroDevs.com, or issues in open source projects discovered by or reported to HeroDevs, unless covered by the scope of another CNA.
Xpdf open source project, including the xpdf viewer and associated command line tools.
Hitachi Energy products only.
Vulnerabilities in vendor products discovered by BLSOPS, or related parties, while performing vulnerability research or security assessments, unless covered by another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities discovered by researchers in collaboration with Maritime Hacking Village that are not in another CNA’s scope.

All products of Medtronic or a Medtronic company including supported products and end-of-life/end-of-service products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered in Medtronic products that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Zscaler issues only.

Vulnerabilities in Delinea products or services listed on delinea.com, or vulnerabilities in third-party products or services discovered by or reported to Delinea, unless covered by the scope of another CNA.
SoftIron HyperCloud branded products and technologies only.
Vulnerabilities discovered by, reported to, or coordinated by, SCHUTZWERK unless covered by another CNA.
All Arista products only.
All Snow Software products.
Teltonika Networks products and services only.
Concrete CMS Core versions 8.5 and above.
All ESET products only and vulnerabilities discovered by ESET that are not covered by another CNA’s scope.
All currently supported PTC software products and cloud/SaaS services.
Vulnerabilities in products and services under the Canon brand.
Kubernetes issues only.
All rami.io GmbH products and open source projects, including pretix, official pretix plugins and apps, and Venueless.
Qualcomm and Snapdragon issues only.
Xerox Corporation issues only.
All EnterpriseDB products and vulnerabilities identified in open source libraries used by EnterpriseDB products unless covered by another CNA’s scope.
Dahua consumer Internet of Things (IoT) products, excludes End-of-Life products.
All Bitdefender products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Bitdefender that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Lexmark products only.
All HDF software including HDF5, HDF4, HSDS, HDFView.
Vulnerabilities in Snyk products and vulnerabilities discovered by, or reported to, Snyk that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Forcepoint products only.
All Acronis products, including Acronis Cyber Protect, Acronis Cyber Protect Home Office, Acronis DeviceLock DLP, and Acronis Snap Deploy.
Thinkst Applied Research’s products only.
All Fortra products and vulnerabilities discovered by Fortra in other products not covered by the scope of another CNA.
openHarmony issues only.
ASR products only.
Trend Micro supported products, including any end-of-life products.
Synology issues only.
Vulnerabilities in PHP code (code in https://github.com/php/php-src) only.
All Network Optix products, including https://www.networkoptix.com/nx-witness and https://www.networkoptix.com/powered-by-nx.
SICK AG issues and issues in EHS products (when related to the Endress+Hauser SICK (EHS) joint venture).
GitHub Enterprise Server issues only.
All Airbus products (supported products and end-of-life/end-of-service products), as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Airbus that are not in another CNA’s scope.
